independent_controls_summary: Actual SciPy on synthetic 220D diagonal operator: both schedules use 200 inner iterations; restart50x4 uses205 actions, restart200x1 uses202; first50 match fixed tolerances.
Explicit zero start and false info0 strict-convergence claim remain separate from true loose forcing/descent/Armijo candidate; four trial states retain the original basepoint.
First50 mismatch callback retained, short prefix rejected.
Tiny synthetic actual Torch Problem counts only three direct gradients while two J2 actions plus one separate HVP consume five HVPs.
Failed HVP restores nesting depth and preserves attempted-versus-returned distinction.
Returned direction persists after synthetic final-action failure.
Sticky termination during operation return preserves value/return event before rejecting all subsequent operations.
Exact-byte replay distinguishes signed zero, dtype, and shape.
limits: No new saved CIFAR target arrays were opened or evaluated, no target/profile/JVP/solve was executed, and no target outcomes are reviewed here. The real solver and Torch tests use only small fabricated synthetic arrays.
Source checks require recorded review commit existence, not semantic proof of review; the external root authorization must pin this reviewed source inventory and exact execution/review commits.
The first50 match is a required prospective control, not a predicted target result. Exact-arithmetic Krylov inclusion does not guarantee finite-precision improvement.

Internal45s is cooperative; external60s TERM plus5s KILL and one-second reaping allowance are separately recorded. RSS2GiB is monitored and transient overshoot is possible; launcher interpreter RSS is additional.
SIGKILL or OS/filesystem failure can prevent final scientific metadata. Already fsynced files and launcher inventory remain evidence; no missing direction or derivative is fabricated.

The Arnoldi basis and all intermediate action vectors are not retained. A later saved-data audit can check final residual/trials/counters and bindings but cannot independently replay the full numerical solve.
A passing direction or trial cannot establish an accepted primitive orbit or any stability, ancestry, utility, or geometry conclusion.
source_findings: Twelve transitive source/card files agree byte-for-byte with the frozen source commit; clean-checkout guard precedes output creation.
Three externally pinned complete regular-file input inventories plus fixed source/state/data/model/rate/library identities precede any target model construction.
202 action,203 J2VP,407 HVP,11 direct-gradient caps count attempted calls; derivative-internal gradients are excluded from the direct-gradient category.
Initial/trial first-map states, returned p/info and final Ap/e are retained before dependent validation or the next map.
Owned process-group launcher has fixed timeout, log/storage limits and monitored RSS; malformed/missing scientific receipts cannot report successful completion.
No target acceptance, continuation update, eigensolver or protected-data access path is added.
